responsibility: This definition file enumerates the built-in functions GCC recognizes for transactional memory support. It names runtime entry points for transaction begin/commit/abort, transactional memory loads and stores of various scalar kinds, logging helpers, TM-aware memcpy/memmove/memset and allocation functions, and backend-provided vector stubs, together with their builtin type signatures and attributes. It is the canonical table used to generate TM builtin registration and classification logic.
